libfst 8f60a7e89556497faffb6e9e4922a1f5a5281569

The original copyright and license notices are retained.

Local changes in fstapi.c, fst_win_unistd.h and the additive fstinput.h:
* Add a portable, fixed-size read_at input ABI to the reader.
* Add an optional fixed hierarchy input through a separate additive entry.
* Stage external raw hierarchy through the same private quota factory.
* Route reader seeks, reads and integer decoding through that ABI.
* Use 4 KiB metadata refills and bounded bulk copies through a 64 KiB cache.
* Preserve the existing filename API for upstream callers.
* Share native Windows mapping, temporary-file and CRT branches across MSVC and MinGW.
* Use 64-bit native Windows seek/truncate offsets and mapped-view offset words.
* Use integer constant expressions for fixed varint buffers.
* Use desktop CRT declarations in the MSVC shim and keep added CRT aliases private.
* Bound callback hierarchy names, varints and EOF handling.
* Expose read-only geometry validation for callback buffer sizes.
* Retain a bounded sparse VC directory during the existing input initialization.
* Reuse indexed section offsets for time windows and point-value cache misses.
* Recheck point-value cache end ticks and walk every adjacent shared-tick section.
* Validate callback block lengths during the existing input initialization.
* Retain callback input errors.
* Apply the callback reader time-range end inside event traversal.
* Mark malformed early traversal exits and retain normal fixed-input EOF.
* Mark traversal failures even when the upstream return value is one.
* Decode gzip and LZ4 hierarchy through a quota-limited temporary factory.
* Reject whole-file wrappers at the native callback entry.

FastLZ and LZ4 remain unmodified. Writer data encoding is unchanged.
